## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are DCO-signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] No real credentials, customer data, or operator-originated real datasets are included
- [ ] Test fixtures are synthetic (fictional names/identifiers), or their real-data basis is
      documented in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` with a confirmed redistribution right
- [ ] If this adds a new external data/standard dependency: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` is updated
      with its licence/redistribution basis
- [ ] No proprietary ranking/scoring/recommendation logic is introduced (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
